title: Gateway menu, draft (yard, owner and display_name are filled by the relay)
description: Published by a yard gateway on join and on change (12 section 9.1 item 1).

owner.description: Owner name, 1 to 128 characters; the relay fills it. Example: Acme.

display_name.description: Display name, 1 to 80 characters; the relay fills it. Example: Acme QA.

visibility.description: private, summary or full. Example: summary.

capabilities.description: Up to 64 capabilities, each {id, description, ...}. Example: [{"id": "regression-test", "description": "Writes a failing test"}]

accept_from.description: Yard slugs or handles allowed to send jobs. Example: ["site"].

auto_accept.description: true accepts allowed jobs without asking.

daily_budget_usd.description: Number 0 or more: daily spend cap in US dollars.

hold_minutes.description: m2: ping the owner when no agent of the yard came online this long after accepting (default 240).

release_minutes.description: m2: give a still-queued job back to the Dispatcher after this long (default 1440).

direct_lines.description: m2: who may open a direct line to one of this yard's agents for a job.

description.description: What this capability does, 1 to 280 characters. Example: Writes a failing test for a reported bug.

inputs.description: Up to 32 input names, 1 to 64 characters each. Example: ["bug report"].

outputs.description: Up to 32 output names, 1 to 64 characters each. Example: ["test file"].

quality_bar.description: Unique quality bar names, up to 32 characters each. Example: ["standard"].

typical_minutes.description: Integer 1 to 10080: usual time to finish.

accepts_files.description: Unique MIME types it accepts. Example: ["text/plain"].

keywords.description: m2: words that route free text to this capability by rule. Example: ["test", "regression"].

stations.description: m2: stations (folder yards, vil_ ids) that do this work. Example: ["vil_01926f3a-0000-7000-8000-000000000001"].

approval.description: m2: accept on the yard's behalf, or ask the owner first.

accept_from.description: m2: "site" (anyone in the site) or yard slugs. Example: ["site"].

accept_when_offline.description: m2: accept and queue while every agent of the yard is offline.

open.description: m2: false closes the capability without removing it.

next.description: m2: capabilities this work usually leads to (likely-next hints). Example: ["code-review"].
